name: MCPJam platform lane stale holds >$5
description: WARN · More than $5 of platform lane holds have been unsettled past their stale age (10 min; 6 h for session cluster rebuilds). Those holds count against lanes until 00:00 UTC.
TRIAGE — open View Query, replace the last line with:
| project feature, staleMicros | sort by staleMicros desc
then read that feature's staleRows, oldestOutstandingAgeMs and maxOrgId from the same snapshot
rationale: WHY THIS EXISTS: a hold that never settles emits nothing more, so only the ledger snapshot can see it. cost_unknown holds are deliberate (the call may have spent money), but $5 of them is a broken settle path, and they quietly shrink an org's lane.
WHY complete:true AND LATEST PER FEATURE: an incomplete snapshot carries no totals by design, and summing two snapshots of the same lane would double it.
WHY THIS THRESHOLD: PROVISIONAL — one $5 findings job, or five $1 generation holds. Re-baseline after seven days.

SOURCE IS NEW: emitted by mcpjam-backend #1463 (lane events, usage funding) and #1470 (snapshot). Until both are in PROD this query returns no rows — an Above monitor stays silent and the deadman would page falsely. Apply only after the prod deploy, with --only <key>.
